id.description:
The id of the plot. Can be set arbitrarily, but a {@link UiApTimeseriesChartSeriesConfig}
needs to reference this id in order to plot data in this plot.

title.description: The title of the plot. This will be displayed in the chart.

height.description: The height of the plot in pixels. If not set, {@link UiApTimeseriesChartUserConfig#minPlotHeight} will be used.

yAxes.description:
Allows the specification of y axes for this plot. {@link UiApTimeseriesChartSeriesConfig} can
specify which y axis to use by setting the {@link UiApTimeseriesChartSeriesConfig#yAxisId} field.

If y axes are not specified, the chart will generate y axes automatically based on the units of each series.

title:
Represents a plot within a {@link UiApTimeseriesChart}.
Utilized by {@link UiApTimeseriesChartSeriesConfig} to determine where to plot data.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartPlotConfig
